results.description:
Meet the sexy heroes of The Dark Kings of NYC. Theses US Marines go undercover in dangerous mafia and criminal families seeking revenge. If you love dark mafia romances with enemies to lovers, second chance love and fake relationships, then you'll love this six-book series which is now complete.

The Dark Kings of NYC Volume One Collection contains:

•The Darkest King
•The Ruthless King
•The Savage King
•The Avenged King

The Darkest King
Now the most powerful man in New York City, Connor has never forgotten the ruthless mafia boss who murdered his family. When he meets the man's daughter, Mia, and agrees to become her fake fiancé, his vengeful plans turn complicated. A red-hot enemies-to-lovers mafia romance!

The Ruthless King
At her friend's wedding, Sienna feels an undeniable attraction to bad boy Nathan, who she doesn't realize belongs to a secret organization of former military men — and he will do anything to protect her from the coming danger…

The Savage King
Marine veteran Decker is deep undercover in a Mexican cartel when sexy — and innocent — Isabelle is tossed into his lap. Tasked with seeing her home to New York City, Decker will have to keep her safe… and his hands to himself! A heart-pounding romantic thriller with a sassy heroine and a protective hero.

The Avenged King
When Mack's childhood sweetheart reappears in his life, he's reminded of the dangerous world they grew up in. Obsessed with finding out what happened in the ten years they were apart and fighting their rekindled spark, he risks his life if old enemies learn he's still alive. Given he shouldn't exist. A dark and spicy second chance love! 

If you enjoy dark spicy romances with suspenseful twists, battling mafia families, and dominant protective heroes, then you'll love this series. 

Expect a happy ever after in every book. Each one has a different couple.
